name: timberfs-apache-combined
description: NCSA common and combined access logs, the format Apache and nginx write by default. A log whose LogFormat has been changed needs an extractor of its own with a fields.extract regex. Requests are labelled by status, so an error rate is a selection over http_requests rather than a metric of its own.

metrics.name: http_requests
metrics.description: requests a minute by status and method

metrics.name: http_bytes
metrics.description: response bytes a minute by status
